therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Fc-optimized antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against CD19-expressing B cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell depletion in CD19-positive lymphoma cells

results.effect_size: ORR: 22 responders (6 CR + 16 PR) out of 92 patients (23.9%)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Profound B-cell depletion observed with median -42.07% change from baseline at Cycle 1 Day 8, reaching -80% by Cycle 3 Day 28
biomarker_changes: B-cell populations decreased by median -42.07% at Day 8, reaching -80% by Cycle 3 Day 28
T-cell populations increased by median 7.28% at Day 8
NK cell populations decreased by median -1.62% at Day 8
subgroup_findings: FcγRIIIa FF genotype showed highest response rate: 10 responders
Median Duration of Response: 24.0 months overall
safety_signals: Serious AEs included anemia (2), febrile neutropenia (1), cardiac failure (1)

context.duration: Treatment for 3 cycles (28 days each), follow-up up to 4.5 years
